## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与变更后的行为

Describe the concrete trigger and expected result. / 说明具体触发条件与修改后的结果。

## Validation / 验证

List the checks actually run and their results. / 列出实际执行的检查及结果。
For code changes: Ruff, focused regression tests, and the full suite. For runtime/package changes: an isolated installed rerun. For visual changes: actual rendered previews and review evidence.

## Compatibility and scope / 兼容性与范围

Note changes to the workflow, Page Spec / Scene, CLI arguments or exit codes, dependencies, and packaging. Describe any remaining limits.
